## Activity

During December 2025, North City Eye Clinic recorded 499 captures. Activity was completed through the scheduled clinic sessions, with session lists running as planned apart from routine leave. Overall activity was maintained across the reporting period, and no disruption to the planned programme was identified in the information provided.

The capture total represents the activity submitted for review during the month. It provides the basis for the image-quality and grading measures set out below.

## Image quality

There were 15 ungradable images. This equates to an ungradable rate of 3.0. The ungradable cases should continue to be monitored as part of routine quality assurance, with local review used to identify any recurring issues affecting image assessment.

## Grading

A total of 141 results were graded referable. The median grading lag was 2 days. These results should be considered alongside the image-quality findings when reviewing the site’s monthly performance. The recorded grading turnaround indicates that submitted results progressed through the grading process within the reported timeframe.
